classification.age_band_note: Book Dash publishes no per-book band; placed by the analyst from content (school playtime, imagined cloud shapes) and text metrics (93 words, mean sentence 3.4 words); 3-4 is equally plausible from the text alone.

age_suitability.notes: Calm everyday discovery with no peril; the dragon is friendly and imagined in clouds. Peak research intensity 4 of 5 (wonder, not fear), about 2 on the engine's 0-3 scale. The split sentence works in text alone; the six children and the dragon's hiding place need pictures (MagicPaper stories are text-only today).
